Scope: apps/accounts/views.py (UserCreateView, UserUpdateView, UserDeleteView / deactivate)
Techniques: EP, BVA, State Transition, Use Case Testing, Negative Testing
Rollback: Django test DB is reset between test classes via @pytest.mark.django_db(transaction=True) + rollback fixture.
CheckDB: Direct psycopg2 / Django ORM queries verify row creation, field values, and status flags.
